decks.notes: The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while putting pressure on them with efficient creatures and spells. It emphasizes card advantage, tempo, and control through cards like Thoughtseize, Brainstorm, and Force of Will. The key strategy is to use disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Wasteland to keep the opponent off balance, while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower to close out the game quickly. The deck aims to control the game's pace and outmaneuver the opponent for a swift victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful Eldrazi creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By ramping up mana with lands like Ancient Tomb and Eldrazi Temple, the deck can play its heavy-hitting creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and It That Heralds the End early in the game. Chalice of the Void disrupts the opponent's strategy, while cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Sowing Mycospawn provide additional threats. The deck aims to close out the game quickly by leveraging its high-powered creatures and disruptive elements to outpace the opponent.

This deck focuses on a fast-paced, aggressive playstyle that aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining board control. It uses a combination of efficient removal spells, counterspells, and disruptive creatures to keep the opponent on the back foot. The deck also includes card draw spells and manipulation effects to ensure consistency and enable powerful plays. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply pressure on the opponent's resources and win the game through tempo advantage and efficient combat interactions.

This UWx Control deck focuses on disruption, removal, and card advantage to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It utilizes powerful interaction spells like Thoughtseize, Prismatic Ending, Swords to Plowshares, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage with Brainstorm and Ponder. Murktide Regent provides a quick clock while Orcish Bowmasters and Psychic Frog control the board. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps filter draws and generate card advantage. The mana base is built to support the deck's color requirements and disrupt the opponent with Wasteland.

The main theme of this Dimir Tempo deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure with efficient threats. Using cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Daze, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and control the game tempo. By combining efficient removal spells with powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, the deck can quickly close out games. The additional disruption provided by Force of Will and Nihil Spellbomb helps keep the opponent off balance, allowing the deck to maintain its aggressive stance throughout the game.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze while also maintaining control of the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. It aims to apply pressure with small but efficient creatures like Barrowgoyf and Dauthi Voidwalker, backed up by powerful threats like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck's tempo strategy revolves around efficiently using its resources to outpace the opponent and maintain control of the game through disruption and aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to establish early board control and disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently closing out the game with aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower. The deck utilizes various disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze, along with removal spells like Fatal Push to maintain tempo and pressure. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Psychic Frog provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck also features powerful card draw and selection with Brainstorm and Ponder, as well as counter magic with Force of Will.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize Mystic Forge along with artifacts like Karn, the Great Creator, Glaring Fleshraker, and Manifold Key to generate a powerful combo that can control the game and overwhelm the opponent. The deck heavily relies on mana acceleration from cards like Basalt Monolith, Grim Monolith, and Lotus Petal, while also taking advantage of cards like Urza's Tower, Urza's Saga, and Ancient Tomb to provide additional resources. The goal is to establish a dominating board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by disrupting the opponent's plans through counterspells and removal while also applying pressure with efficient threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower. The deck aims to maintain card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, while also being able to disrupt the opponent's graveyard strategies with Nihil Spellbomb. By maintaining control of the board and staying ahead in resources, the deck can quickly close out the game before the opponent can recover.

The deck focuses on using Mystic Forge to quickly assemble powerful combos, utilizing artifacts like Basalt Monolith, Grim Monolith, and Manifold Key to generate large amounts of mana. Cards like Urza's Saga, Karn, the Great Creator, and Urza's Tower provide additional support for the artifact-based strategy. The goal is to establish board control with powerful creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Candy Trail while maintaining a steady flow of card advantage and resources. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its efficient combo potential and oppressive artifact synergy.

The main focus of this Dragon Stompy Legacy deck is to disrupt opponents with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Sundering Eruption while quickly deploying threats like Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf to apply pressure. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration from Chrome Mox, City of Traitors, and Simian Spirit Guide to quickly cast powerful spells like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fury. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Shatterskull Smashing provide additional versatility and reach to the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with high-powered creatures using cards like Dark Ritual, Entomb, and Cabal Therapy, then bringing them back to the battlefield for a powerful combo finish. The goal is to reanimate creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty to overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruptive cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. Multiple options for reanimation spells and a diverse selection of threats like Atraxa and Koma provide flexibility in strategy based on the matchup.

This deck aims to control the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It leverages powerful creatures like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Curie, Emergent Intelligence to pressure the opponent while also providing card advantage with Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Dress Down and Consign to Memory to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes mana denial with Wasteland to further control the board and slow down the opponent's development.

This deck focuses on using disruptive spells and creatures to control the board while applying pressure with evasive threats. By utilizing cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Orcish Bowmasters to disrupt the opponent's strategy and Murktide Regent to close out the game quickly, the deck aims to establish early dominance and maintain control throughout the match. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will allows the deck to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own threats, while efficient removal spells like Fatal Push help keep the board clear.

The main concept of this Bant Control Legacy deck is to utilize powerful control elements such as counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and value through cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Monastery Mentor provide additional versatility and win conditions for the deck. The deck also utilizes land disruption through cards like Wasteland and efficient mana fixing through fetch lands to ensure consistent mana development.

The main concept of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by using removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, as well as card draw and selection tools like Brainstorm and Ponder. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card advantage and utility while Nihil Spellbomb helps disrupt graveyard strategies. Wasteland and Undercity Sewers are included for mana denial and disruption.
